scope: Frozen all-synthetic and all-exposed diagnostic regression; not independent acceptance

query_rule.method: Deterministic extraction, no model or term insertion; preserve original plus exactly two original clauses
query_rule.boundaries: Chinese comma, semicolon, question mark outside balanced quotes/brackets
query_rule.eligibility: Both clauses contain interrogative markers and at least six characters; no backticks or over-512-character input; ambiguous input remains original only
query_rule.limitations: Extracted clauses may lose shared subjects or cross-clause conditions; retaining original query does not guarantee semantic equivalence or zero regressions

budgets.retained_per_route: Unchanged total 30 keyword, 15 semantic; not 30/15 per subquery
budgets.branch_combination: Schedule two original unique chunks, one first-clause chunk, one second-clause chunk repeatedly; dedup by actual chunk ID, backfill exhausted lists, keep selected native score
budgets.hydration: Each actual recall branch runs existing publication/revision/permission rechecks; select only metadata-eligible candidates within total route cap
budgets.cost: Split routes triple index requests and metadata/visibility batches; clauses-both also triples query embeddings. Raw hit caps are fixed, request overhead is not fixed

selection: Compare every individual pool evidence hit against same-run off baseline, report gained/lost evidence and final selection side effects. Do not promote a mode on one rescued known question or aggregate gains with new evidence losses.
stop_rules: One pass through the three frozen modes; do not retune split markers, proportions or questions after inspecting results
If neither split mode yields stable pool evidence gains without losses, retain off and record no adoption
No changes to chunking, indexed context, model, cross-route fusion, reranking or answer generation
No business deployment or public debug endpoint
http_parity: Verify original unsplit diagnostic path against existing HTTP at 15:15; split modes remain internal experiments and do not claim HTTP split-path parity
timings: One serial measured pass per mode; branch durations are summed work and route elapsed is wall time; no production latency or throughput conclusion
